reply.thought: The reported refunds match the signed requests. I will check the ledger to verify that the requested refunds were actually applied correctly before making any payouts.
The refund ledger matches the signed requests exactly. I will check the orders to identify customers and confirm the refunds correspond to valid orders.
Each refund is for a valid order and is within that order's amount; Alpha's work is complete and consistent with the signed requests. I will obtain acme's net balance from the ledger.
The refund checks passed, and the ledger gives acme a net balance of 21583 cents. I will record acme's single payout.
I will obtain birch's net balance from the ledger rather than calculating it myself.
